jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer, Pricing AI/ML
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About the team

Modelco trains and ships language models. The Applied AI Engineering team is small, works in the open inside the company, and ships every week.

About the role

As a member of the Applied AI Engineering team you will own pricing and ranking models work from idea to production. You will pair with colleagues in research and product and be trusted with real responsibility early.

Responsibilities

  • Design, build and operate pricing and ranking models services that run in production.
  • Improve on-call tooling so incidents are rarer and shorter.
  • Keep dashboards and runbooks for pricing and ranking models accurate and easy to follow.
  • Work with research and product to move prototypes into reliable systems.

Qualifications

  • 3+ years of professional software engineering experience in Python or a similar language.
  • Hands-on experience with Python, PyTorch and experimentation platforms.
  • A record of owning a system from the first commit to steady operation.
  • Clear written communication and a preference for simple designs.

Nice to have

  • Open-source contributions in the pricing and ranking models area.
  • Experience with distributed training or large-scale data processing.

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Software Engineer - Bay Area
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About the team

Modelco trains and ships language models. The Forward Deployed Engineering team is small, works in the open inside the company, and ships every week.

About the role

As a member of the Forward Deployed Engineering team you will own forward deployed engineering work from idea to production. You will pair with colleagues in research and product and be trusted with real responsibility early.

Responsibilities

  • Turn open product questions into measurable experiments and ship the ones that win.
  • Work with research and product to move prototypes into reliable systems.
  • Keep dashboards and runbooks for forward deployed engineering accurate and easy to follow.
  • Write short design documents and review code from the people you work with.

Qualifications

  • A record of owning a system from the first commit to steady operation.
  • Hands-on experience with Python, TypeScript and cloud platforms.
  • Comfort reading research papers and turning them into working code.
  • 3+ years of professional software engineering experience in Python or a similar language.

Nice to have

  • Open-source contributions in the forward deployed engineering area.
  • Prior work on evaluation, red-teaming or reliability for learned systems.
